verses.en: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
verses.pt: E o anjo do SENHOR subiu de Gilgal a Boquim, e disse: “Eu vos tirei do Egito, e vos introduzi na terra da qual havia jurado a vossos pais; e disse: ‘Não invalidarei jamais meu pacto convosco;
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.
verses.en_bbe: Now the angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim. And he said, *** I took you out of Egypt, guiding you into the land which I gave by an oath to your fathers; and I said, My agreement with you will never be broken by me:

verses.en: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?
verses.pt: contanto que vós não façais aliança com os moradores desta terra, cujos altares deveis derrubar’; mas vós não atendestes à minha voz: por que fizestes isto?
verses.en_web: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make no agreement with the people of this land; you are to see that their altars are broken down: but you have not given ear to my voice: what have you done?

verses.en: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
verses.pt: Por isso eu também disse: ‘Não os expulsarei de diante de vós, mas serão vossos inimigos, e seus deuses vos serão uma armadilha’”.
verses.en_web: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”
verses.en_bbe: And so I have said, I will not send them out from before you; but they will be a danger to you, and their gods will be a cause of falling to you.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.pt: E quando o anjo do SENHOR falou estas palavras a todos os filhos de Israel, o povo chorou em alta voz.
verses.en_web: When Yahweh’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.en_bbe: Now on hearing these words which the angel of the Lord said to all the children of Israel, the people gave themselves up to loud crying and weeping.

verses.en: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD.
verses.pt: E chamaram por nome aquele lugar Boquim: e sacrificaram ali ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave that place the name of Bochim, and made offerings there to the Lord.

verses.en: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
verses.pt: Porque já Josué havia despedido ao povo, e os filhos de Israel se haviam ido cada um à sua herança para possuí-la.
verses.en_web: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.
verses.en_bbe: And Joshua let the people go away, and the children of Israel went, every man to his heritage, to take the land for themselves.

verses.en: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.
verses.pt: E o povo havia servido ao SENHOR todo aquele tempo de Josué, e todo aquele tempo dos anciãos que viveram longos dias depois de Josué, os quais viram todas as grandes obras do SENHOR, que o havia feito por Israel.
verses.en_web: The people served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of Yahweh that he had worked for Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And the people were true to the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the responsible men who were still living after the death of Joshua, and had seen all the great work of the Lord which he had done for Israel.

verses.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
verses.pt: E morreu Josué filho de Num, servo do SENHOR, sendo de cento e dez anos.
verses.en_web: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.
verses.en_bbe: And death came to Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, he being a hundred and ten years old.

verses.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
verses.pt: E enterraram-no no termo de sua herança em Timnate-Heres, no monte de Efraim, o norte do monte de Gaás.
verses.en_web: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
verses.en_bbe: And they put his body in the earth in the land of his heritage in Timnath-heres, in the hill-country of Ephraim to the north of Mount Gaash.

verses.en: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.
verses.pt: E toda aquela geração foi também recolhida com seus pais. E levantou-se depois dela outra geração, que não conhecia o SENHOR, nem a obra que ele havia feito por Israel.
verses.en_web: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them, who didn’t know Yahweh, nor the work which he had done for Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And in time death overtook all that generation; and another generation came after them, having no knowledge of the Lord or of the things which he had done for Israel.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:
verses.pt: E os filhos de Israel fizeram o que era mal aos olhos do SENHOR, e serviram aos baalins;
verses.en_web: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord and became servants to the Baals;

verses.en: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.
verses.pt: E abandonaram o SENHOR, o Deus de seus pais, que os havia tirado da terra do Egito, e seguiram outros deuses, os deuses dos povos que estavam em seus arredores, aos quais adoraram, e provocaram à ira ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: They abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked Yahweh to anger.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave up the Lord, the God of their fathers, who had taken them out of the land of Egypt, and went after other gods, the gods of the peoples round about them, worshipping them and moving the Lord to wrath.

verses.en: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
verses.pt: Pois abandonaram o SENHOR, e adoraram a Baal e a Astarote.
verses.en_web: They abandoned Yahweh, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave up the Lord, and became the servants of Baal and the Astartes.

verses.en: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
verses.pt: Então a fúria do SENHOR se acendeu contra Israel, e os entregou nas mãos de saqueadores que os despojaram, e os vendeu nas mãos de seus inimigos ao redor; e não puderam mais resistir diante dos seus inimigos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.
verses.en_bbe: And the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he gave them up into the hands of those who violently took their property, and into the hands of their haters all round them, so that they were forced to give way before them.

verses.en: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.
verses.pt: Por de onde quer que saíssem, a mão do SENHOR era contra eles para o mal, como o SENHOR havia dito, e como o SENHOR lhes havia jurado; assim estiveram em grande aflição.
verses.en_web: Wherever they went out, Yahweh’s hand was against them for evil, as Yahweh had spoken, and as Yahweh had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.
verses.en_bbe: Wherever they went out, the hand of the Lord was against them for evil, as the Lord had taken his oath it would be; and things became very hard for them.

verses.en: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
verses.pt: Mas o SENHOR suscitou juízes que os livrassem da mão dos que os despojavam.
verses.en_web: Yahweh raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord gave them judges, as their saviours from the hands of those who were cruel to them.

verses.en: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; but they did not so.
verses.pt: Mas também não ouviram aos seus juízes; em vez disso, prostituíram-se seguindo outros deuses, aos quais adoraram; desviaram-se depressa do caminho em que seus pais andaram, obedecendo aos mandamentos do SENHOR; porém eles não fizeram assim.
verses.en_web: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying Yahweh’s commandments. They didn’t do so.
verses.en_bbe: But still they would not give ear to their judges, but went after other gods and gave them worship; quickly turning from the way in which their fathers had gone, keeping the orders of the Lord; but they did not do so.

verses.en: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
verses.pt: E quando o SENHOR lhes suscitava juízes, o SENHOR era com o juiz, e os livrava da mão dos inimigos todo aquele tempo daquele juiz, porque o SENHOR se arrependia pelo gemideles, por causa dos que os oprimiam e afligiam.
verses.en_web: When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved Yahweh because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.
verses.en_bbe: And whenever the Lord gave them judges, then the Lord was with the judge, and was their saviour from the hands of their haters all the days of the judge; for the Lord was moved by their cries of grief because of those who were cruel to them.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
verses.pt: Mas acontecia que, quando o juiz morria, eles se voltavam para trás, e se corrompiam mais que seus pais, seguindo outros deuses para os adorarem e se inclinarem diante deles; e nada cessavam de suas obras, nem de seu teimoso caminho.
verses.en_web: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.
verses.en_bbe: But whenever the judge was dead, they went back and did more evil than their fathers, going after other gods, to be their servants and their worshippers; giving up nothing of their sins and their hard-hearted ways.

verses.en: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
verses.pt: Então a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Israel, e disse: "Visto que este povo transgride o meu pacto que ordenei aos seus pais, e não dá ouvidos à minha voz,
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,
verses.en_bbe: And the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he said, Because this nation has not been true to my agreement which I made with their fathers, and has not given ear to my voice;

verses.en: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
verses.pt: eu também não expulsarei mais de diante deles a nenhuma das nações que Josué deixou quando morreu;
verses.en_web: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;
verses.en_bbe: From now on I will not go on driving out from before them any of the nations which at the death of Joshua were still living in this land;

verses.en: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
verses.pt: para que por elas eu provasse os israelitas, se guardariam o caminho do SENHOR andando por ele, como seus pais o guardaram, ou não.
verses.en_web: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep Yahweh’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”
verses.en_bbe: In order to put Israel to the test, and see if they will keep the way of the Lord, walking in it as their fathers did, or not.

verses.en: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
verses.pt: Por isso o SENHOR deixou aquelas nações, e não as tirou logo, nem as entregou nas mãos de Josué.
verses.en_web: So Yahweh left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord let those nations go on living in the land, not driving them out quickly, and did not give them up into the hands of Joshua.
